news.title: My Bitcoin allocation is bigger than my retirement account
news.summary:
I did not mean to buy much bitcoin. I just bought bitcoin every month for the last few years and did not really think about it. I checked my accounts this week, and my bitcoin position is now larger than my entire retirement portfolio.

This is not what I wanted when I started buying bitcoin. Now I am looking at my portfolio, and I am wondering if I am making a good decision by letting my bitcoin investment grow, or a bad one by not changing my portfolio.<
